title: 28 加入下29 交易30 刀随身换
content_zh:
……
“不用这么客气。”
“收起读书人那套，咱习武之人没那么多礼节。”
“对了，瞧我这记性。你小子最看重银两了，我差点忘记说了。”
徐敬武笑道。
他当初让贾彦勇请林哲羽过来说书，这小子就是因为自己不给钱，所以给拒绝了。
“哈，哈……”
林哲羽有些尴尬地笑了笑。
他当初因为先入为主的印象，觉得混帮派的都不是好人。
再加上贾彦勇说不给钱，林哲羽的印象更差了，当场就给拒绝了。
请人说书，哪有不给钱的理？
不过随着接触，林哲羽发现徐敬武并不是他想象中那副凶神恶煞，恶贯满盈的模样。
徐敬武给人一种儒雅随和的感觉，而且出手极为大方。
刚刚林哲羽看他一高兴，就打赏了唱戏的一两银子。
估计林哲羽当时如果答应了，说的徐敬武满意，也能获得不少的打赏。
“你的实力比贾彦勇几人强一些，不过没有做出什么贡献，所以给你的银两跟他们一样，每月五两银子，你看如何？”
徐敬武说道。
普通小弟，一个月一般也就一千三百文钱。
像贾彦勇、谢江这种实力强点的，一个月能有五两银子。
“嗯，有五两银子我已经很满意了。”

林哲羽笑着说道，说完打趣了声：“不过帮主下次想听书的话，还是需要另付工钱的。”
“哈哈哈！”
“给，必须给。”
“说好了，我还重重有赏！”
徐敬武哈哈笑道。
林哲羽陪徐帮主又看了一场戏才离开。
徐帮主是个大忙人，下午约了王姑娘、陈姑娘游园，晚上安排了百花楼。
每天生活过得忙碌充实，而又朴实无华。
……
百味街。
红莱酒楼。
贾彦勇、谢江、林哲羽三人坐在一桌。
“来，我敬林兄弟一碗，欢迎林兄弟加入飞虹帮。”谢江举起酒碗说道。
林哲羽拿起酒碗，和谢江碰了碰，一饮而尽。
他重新将酒满上，对贾彦勇说道：“我敬勇哥一碗，以后我们就是兄弟了，以前的恩怨一笔勾销。”
“哈哈，以前是我做的不是，这碗该我敬你！”贾彦勇豪爽地笑道，在做兄弟这方面，他这人没话说。
两人碗碰碗，一口闷。
几碗酒下肚，氛围活络起来。
“吃完饭后，待会我带你去和其他兄弟们认识认识。”贾彦勇说道。
content_en:
…
"Don't be so polite."
"Stop being a scholar, we martial arts practitioners don't have that much etiquette."
"By the way, look at my memory. Silver is the most important thing to you. I almost forgot to mention it."
Xu Jingwu smiled.
He originally asked Jia Yanyong to invite Lin Zheyu to come over and speak, but the boy refused because he didn't want to pay.
"Ha, ha..."
Lin Zheyu smiled awkwardly.
At first, because of his preconceived impression, he felt that those who were in gangs were not good people.
In addition, Jia Yanyong said he would not pay, which made Lin Zheyu's impression even worse and he refused on the spot.
How can there be no reason not to pay for someone to be a storyteller?
However, with the contact, Lin Zheyu discovered that Xu Jingwu was not as ferocious and full of evil as he imagined.
Xu Jingwu gives people a refined and easy-going feeling, and is extremely generous with his actions.
Just now, Lin Zheyu saw that he was happy and rewarded him with a tael of silver for singing.
It is estimated that if Lin Zheyu had agreed and made Xu Jingwu satisfied, he would have received a lot of rewards.
"You are stronger than Jia Yanyong and the others, but you have not made much contribution, so the silver tael given to you is the same as theirs, five taels of silver per month. What do you think?"
Xu Jingwu said.
An ordinary boy only earns 1,300 coins a month.
Strong people like Jia Yanyong and Xie Jiang can earn five taels of silver a month.
"Well, I'm satisfied with five taels of silver."
Lin Zheyu said with a smile, and then joked: "But if the gang leader wants to listen to the book next time, he still needs to pay extra."
"Hahaha!"
"Give, must give."
"As promised, I will reward you heavily!"
Xu Jingwu laughed.
Lin Zheyu watched one more show with Gang Leader Xu before leaving.
Gang Leader Xu is a busy man. He made an appointment with Miss Wang and Miss Chen to visit the garden in the afternoon, and arranged a trip to Baihua Tower in the evening.
Every day life is busy and fulfilling, yet unpretentious.
…
Baiwei Street.
Hong Lai Restaurant.
Jia Yanyong, Xie Jiang, and Lin Zheyu were sitting at the same table.
"Here, I'll give Brother Lin a bowl and welcome Brother Lin to join the Feihong Gang." Xie Jiang said, raising his wine bowl.
Lin Zheyu picked up the wine bowl, touched it with Xie Jiang, and drank it all in one gulp.
He filled the glass of wine again and said to Jia Yanyong: "I'll give Brother Yong a bowl. We will be brothers from now on, and the past grudges will be wiped out."
"Haha, I was the one who made it before, so I should respect you for this bowl!" Jia Yanyong said with a generous smile. When it comes to being a brother, he has nothing to say.
The two of them clinked their bowls against each other and took a sip.
After a few bowls of wine, the atmosphere became lively.
"After dinner, I will take you to meet the other brothers later." Jia Yanyong said.
